name: Ju Qing Beng Huai! Si Le Shi Yi Nian De Bai Yue Guang Hui Lai Le
original_name: 剧情崩坏！死了十一年的白月光回来了
overview: 18-year-old Lin Mo travels to the eleventh year after her death. She discovers that her world is a novel, and she and her three younger brothers are merely tools in the story. In order to save herself and her brothers from a tragic fate, Lin Mo begins to resist. Along the way, she suddenly realizes that the domineering CEO who has always silently accompanied her is actually the biggest variable in the novel world.
